pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with predominantly rounded vertices. Edge gradients are soft and diffuse due to low image sharpness. Patches vary in size across the visible neck and flank sections.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating the dark patches. Junction nodes typically exhibit tri-radial or quadri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is variable but generally consistent in the mid-flank region.
